title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Traffic - TrafficMeasurementDevice
description: Traffic measurement device, a type of traffic equipment which performs measurements of properties such as service level, traffic intensity and traffic load (edinttrafico:TrafficMeasurementDevice, subclass of sosa:Sensor and edinttrafico:TrafficEquipment). Renamed from 'TrafficMeasuringDevice' used in edint-infraestructura's own bundled v0.2.1 copy; NOTE this newer version no longer carries numDirections/urban (moved exclusively to the new ControlEquipment sibling) -- see standard-metadata.yaml.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TrafficMeasurementDevice'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

monitors.description: Relationship. The StreetSection(s) this equipment monitors (edinttrafico:monitors).

trafficEquipmentType.description: Relationship. Type of traffic equipment. The source ontology does not publish a controlled vocabulary for this yet; kept as a generic Relationship.

observableProperty.description: Relationship. The property this device is capable of detecting (SOSA sosa:observes, inherited via edinttrafico:TrafficMeasurementDevice's Sensor parent). The source ontology does not enumerate specific TrafficProperty instances; kept as a generic Relationship.

inService.description: Property. Whether the device is currently working/in service or not (edinttrafico:inService).

measurementFrequency.description: Property. The measurement frequency of the device (edinttrafico:measurementFrequency). The source ontology does not constrain the format.
